name: Caramelised Banana & Coconut Overnight Oats
steps: For the oats, whisk the yoghurt, water, oats and chia and poppy seeds together, season with as much maple syrup and salt as you like.Cover and chill in the fridge for at least 4 hrs, or overnight.

For the topping, add the coconut and sunflower seeds onto a baking tray. Once the oven is hot, slide in and bake for 7-10 mins until toasted and golden. Once ready, remove from the oven and drizzle over the maple syrup and season with salt, mixing together. Slide it back into the oven for 3-5 mins.Let it cool fully before transferring into a jar or Tupperware container.

For the banana, peel and slice into 1cm slices. 
Set a frying pan over medium heat and add in the coconut oil. Once hot, add the banana, fry on one side for 5-7 mins until caramelised, then tip in the remaining maple syrup and stir together. 
Season with a touch of salt and remove from the heat.
Once the oats have thickened, spoon into jars or containers, top with the bananas and sprinkle over the toasted coconut sprinkle. Dig in!
